name: Building A Tower
overview: The biblical account of building a tower, as seen in Genesis 11:1 and 11:4, reveals humanity's attempt to unify under one language and construct a city with a tower reaching to heaven, motivated by a desire to make a name for themselves and avoid being scattered. This contrasts with God's original command in Genesis 1:28 to multiply and fill the earth, exercising dominion over it. Luke 14:28 emphasizes the wisdom of careful planning and counting the cost before undertaking such a project, highlighting the importance of purposeful and God-honoring labor rather than prideful self-exaltation.
